summary: A fun space adventure where players collect space debris, avoid satellites, and manage fuel to protect Earth's orbit and keep space safe!
details: Space Guardians is a fun and educational space adventure game where players become space heroes on a mission to clean up Earth's orbit. Players collect space debris, avoid collisions with active satellites, and manage limited fuel to complete their missions. The game raises awareness about space pollution and inspires players to protect the future of space exploration.
